rooms.title: Atomic Gallery
rooms.purpose: Explore element identity and sourced atomic properties.
rooms.visitorAction: Select an element and inspect its identity, units, and source.
rooms.authoritativeState: Element definitions and provenance supplied by the selected data capability.
rooms.evidenceRule: Do not infer molecular, reaction, or bulk-material behavior from element identity alone.

rooms.title: Molecular Assembly
rooms.purpose: Compose candidate species from atoms and bonds.
rooms.visitorAction: Add atoms, propose bonds, and inspect validation diagnostics.
rooms.authoritativeState: Versioned species graph, isotope counts, charge, bond order, and geometry model.
rooms.evidenceRule: A drawn structure is only a candidate until the selected chemistry rules validate it.

rooms.title: Reaction Theatre
rooms.purpose: Define reactions and inspect balancing and stoichiometric accounting.
rooms.visitorAction: Choose reactants and products, then request a balance and conservation report.
rooms.authoritativeState: Species references, reaction conditions, balanced coefficients, and conservation diagnostics.
rooms.evidenceRule: A balanced equation does not prove that a reaction occurs under the chosen conditions.

rooms.title: Thermal Observatory
rooms.purpose: Track explicitly modeled energy transfer and thermal state.
rooms.visitorAction: Inspect energy terms and change one declared initial condition.
rooms.authoritativeState: Named energy reservoirs, property data, initial conditions, and selected model outputs.
rooms.evidenceRule: Only display computed temperature or heat-release curves when a named model produces them with units.

rooms.title: Combustion Chamber
rooms.purpose: Study the modeled relationship among fuel, oxidizer, heat, surface, and transport.
rooms.visitorAction: Inspect a benign reference scenario and compare supported model parameters.
rooms.authoritativeState: Surface combustion state coupled to explicitly selected reaction and transport models.
rooms.evidenceRule: A combustion cell state is not, by itself, a validated flame or reaction-kinetics simulation.

rooms.title: Materials Bench
rooms.purpose: Compare versioned material definitions and measured or modeled properties.
rooms.visitorAction: Select materials and compare properties with units and provenance.
rooms.authoritativeState: Material identity and a defined, versioned property set.
rooms.evidenceRule: Do not derive bulk material behavior from elemental composition unless a validated model supports it.

rooms.title: Evidence & Timeline
rooms.purpose: Make experiment assumptions, revisions, results, and provenance inspectable.
rooms.visitorAction: Step or replay a run, compare revisions, and export the experiment record.
rooms.authoritativeState: Experiment revision, inputs, selected model/version, outputs, units, and validation results.
rooms.evidenceRule: Label every result as concept, authored data, calculated, simulated, or validated; preserve run identity.
